video_title: Kon Knueppel Thinks The Hornets Are Ready To EXPLODE

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the Hornets' team chemistry and recent contract extensions
quotes.excerpt: We got a good group that I enjoy being around all the time.
quotes.quote: We got a good group that I enjoy being around all the time. Kobe White is a great guy to be around, just signed him to a big contract this off-season. Brandon Miller just signed a big extension yesterday, so we are really pumped for him. It is a different group, we are trying to get everybody up to speed on the brand of basketball we want to play.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Grayson Allen and Moussa Diabate's development
quotes.excerpt: Grayson Allen has had a really good early pre-season, late summer.
quotes.quote: Grayson Allen has had a really good early pre-season, late summer. He will be a big player for us. Moussa Diabate has been an animal, put on a ton of muscle this off-season.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the versatility of Naz Reid
quotes.excerpt: For a guy his size, he is super talented at a lot of things.
quotes.quote: For a guy his size, he is super talented at a lot of things. His ability to handle, his ability to catch and shoot, make decisions out of the post is something we have been trying to work on early in this pre-season. He is a four, small-ball five that can handle, get the rebound and go.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Brandon Miller's simplified game and growth
quotes.excerpt: It just seems like the game has slowed down a little bit for him.
quotes.quote: It just seems like the game has slowed down a little bit for him in the last year and a half, and just simplifying his game. You see a lot of guys do that, Jayson Tatum has done that. It just makes it easier on you. How can we get him in spots where he is only got to take one or two dribbles to score, to make a play, to pass?

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the toughness of Cason Wallace
quotes.excerpt: He is a player I really, really like. I think he is very, very talented.
quotes.quote: Cason Wallace, I think he is very, very talented, very good. I think offensively, he is one of the best defenders in the league, but I think he is a very good offensively too. I think he is one of the tougher players to play against.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the Hornets' goal to be a playoff team
quotes.excerpt: We believe we can be a playoff team, and that is what you need to do.
quotes.quote: We got a taste of post-season basketball last year in the play-in, and we want to be in the real thing. That is the goal for us. We want to play to that standard, hold each other to that. We understand that is not going to be easy, but if we play to that standard every night, we believe we can be a playoff team.
